title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Outreach Optimization Agent picks email send times
summary: The briefing's enablement controls, consumption licensing and roadmap targets are supported by Microsoft's documentation and the supplied record. It correctly distinguishes the preview's continued email sends from the roadmap's planned early exit. A minor checklist-to-table mismatch remains for consumption reporting.

claims.claim: Outreach Optimization Agent is an AI journey step in Customer Insights - Journeys that chooses marketing email send times.
claims.quote: Outreach Optimization Agent is an AI-powered journey step in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys that optimizes when your marketing emails are sent.

claims.claim: The agent chooses message cadence.
claims.quote: Instead of relying on fixed schedules, the agent dynamically determines optimal send times and cadence, helping ensure that outreach is delivered when customers are more likely to engage.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a baseline messaging plan built from historical engagement.
claims.quote: Outreach Optimization Agent automatically creates a baseline messaging plan for your audience by analyzing overall historical engagement patterns

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions

claims.quote: The agent continuously monitors incoming signals, including engagement and non-responsiveness, and adjusts follow-up timing and cadence, or exits the plan based on whether the goal is progressing or has been achieved.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes quiet times as a hard constraint.
claims.quote: The agent enforces quiet time settings as a hard constraint, ensuring that messages are never sent outside approved communication windows, even if engagement data suggests otherwise.

claims.claim: The preview agent honours configured quiet times.
claims.quote: The agent respects your organization's configured quiet times. Even if historical data suggests a high-engagement window outside permitted hours (for example, late at night), the agent won't schedule emails during quiet-time periods.

claims.claim: The preview agent honours contact point consent.
claims.quote: The agent respects the communication preferences set for each contact or lead. If a contact has opted out of email communication on a specific address, no email is sent to that address.
